card.name: Sequential versus simultaneous drug administration
card.fires_on: Words describing how two drugs or commands are given relative to each other, such as sequentially, separately, simultaneous, or "one after the other", mostly right after "administered".

modes.label: Sequential or separate giving
modes.description: Adverb after administered or used saying two products are given in turn or apart.

modes.label: One after the other
modes.description: Phrase describing running items in order, including the word after in a command-line list.

modes.label: Inside concomitant
modes.description: Partway through concomitant or similar words about drugs used together.
